name: finchpad-web
description: finchpad frontend. Kept as its own package so the backend service — which sits next to a signing key — keeps its zero-dependency posture.
_overridesNote: Transitive pins, not preferences: Privy 3.35.1 ships viem 2.52.0 (advisory range <=2.54.1), which drags in a vulnerable ws; axios arrives via @coinbase/cdp-sdk. All three are patch/minor bumps inside the same major. This is the wallet-signing page, so it does not ship known-vulnerable crypto libs. uuid is pinned for the same reason (bounds check in v3/v5/v6). Revisit when Privy bumps upstream.
